Moksh nagri gayaji pinddan ke sath-sath kaee aitihasik mandiron ke lie bhi jani jati hai. aitihasik mandiron men brahmani ghat par sthit sury mandir bhi hai. khasbat ye hai ki bhagvan sury aadikal se pure parivar ke sath is mandir men virajman hain.
